title: Wisdom in Judgment
paragraphs: Prophet Sulaiman was known not only for the considerable wealth and authority he possessed, but for the careful, thoughtful reasoning he applied when resolving disputes brought before him by his people.

In one well-known account, he arrived at a fair resolution to a complicated dispute by observing subtle details others had overlooked, revealing a deeper truth beneath the surface of competing claims.
What distinguishes his approach in these accounts is not merely reaching correct conclusions, but the patient, methodical process of examining evidence carefully before making any final judgment.

His example continues to influence discussions about fair leadership today, emphasizing that genuine wisdom often requires setting aside quick assumptions in favor of careful, deliberate examination of the full situation.
